issues.detail: The Hebrew 'כְּבוֹדָ֖ם בְּקָל֥וֹן אָמִֽיר' means 'I will turn their glory into shame' (or 'their glory I will change into disgrace'), but the Chinese renders it as '他們的榮耀在於羞辱' ('their glory consists in shame'), which changes the meaning from a divine action of transformation to a static description. The verb 'אָמִיר' (I will change/exchange) is omitted, and the sense of future divine judgment is lost.
